吐.def: to vomit, to spew out, to cough up; to say

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 土 (earth) as the sound: to spit out, to vomit.

吐.name: spit

origin.says: A picture of a person bent or slumped over: a body, a corpse. The traditional 屍 (corpse, with 死 death) was merged into it.

尸.name: corpse
尸.in: 展据呢属局居剧层避届屋握刷屁屠泥壁屏慰漏辟履崛臂掘臀尼屈尾妮殿譬屡犀屑劈屉屎僻嘱倔尿涮蔚锯瞩霹卢颅尉窟辗碾璧

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 乇 as the sound: a dwelling, a home.
A late character, from about the Yuan-Ming period: 身 (body) for the meaning plus 尚 (esteem) as the sound: to lie down.

擦.def: to clean, to erase, to polish; a brush

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 察 (examine) as the sound: to rub and wipe by hand.

擦.name: wipe

ety.hint: Something dangerous 危 to one's flesh ⺼

origin.says: First 脃: ⺼ (meat) for the meaning plus a shortened 絕 (cut off) as the sound: meat that snaps, brittle. The right part later took the shape 危 (danger).

渡.def: to cross, to ferry over, to pass through

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 度 (degree) as the sound: to cross a river, to ferry over, to pass through.

渡.name: ferry

origin.says: 中 (middle) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: a heart held centred and true, loyalty.

填.def: to fill, to pad, to stuff

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 真 (true) as the sound: filling a hole with earth, to fill in.

填.name: fill in

origin.says: Simplified from 湯: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 昜 (sunlit) as the sound; first 'hot water', later 'soup'. The sound part was shortened to its cursive shape 𠃓.
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 巟 (wide flood waters) as the sound: land overgrown with weeds, waste and barren.

ety.hint: One with wooden 木 speech 口

origin.says: 口 (mouth) over 木 (tree, wood): one reading is a mouth stuck like a block of wood, speechless, dull. The shape is also an old variant of 保 (to protect).

ety.hint: Grass 艹 growing in a field 田

origin.says: 艹 (grass) over 田 (field): young plants coming up in the field, sprouts.

ety.hint: A heart ⺼ in the chest 匈; 匈 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 月 (flesh) added to 匈 (chest), which gives the sound and was the original form: the chest, the breast, and by extension the heart and mind.

怨.def: to blame, to complain, to hate; enmity, resentment

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 夗 (curled up) as the sound: a feeling coiled in the heart, resentment.

怨.name: resentment

ety.hint: A plate or flat dish; an everyday item

origin.says: An old drawing, perhaps of a plate or tray; one reading says its origin is unknown. It was early used for its sound, and 'every, ordinary' is a borrowed meaning.

凡.name: ordinary
凡.in: 同筑恐赢洞巩铜帆筒矾桐

糊.def: muddled; paste; to stick on with paste

origin.says: 米 (rice) for the meaning plus 胡 (reckless) as the sound: a rice paste or porridge, to glue; then 'muddled'.

糊.name: paste

ety.hint: The remains of a fire 火; 火 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 𠂇 (hand, a squeezed form of 又) over 火 (fire): fire that has burned down far enough to be touched by hand, that is ash; hence also grey.

杉.def: various species of pine and fir

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 彡 (hair strokes) as the sound: the China fir.

杉.name: fir

origin.says: 气 (air, vapour) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound: vapours in the air, then atmosphere or mood.

吵.def: to argue, to dispute; to annoy, to disturb

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 少 (few) as the sound: noisy, to quarrel.

吵.name: quarrel

扫.def: to clean, to sweep, to wipe away; to weed out; to wipe out

ety.hint: Simplified form of 掃; to use 扌 a broom 帚; 帚 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 掃: 扌 (hand) plus 帚 (broom): a hand with a broom, to sweep. The simplification kept only the top 彐 of 帚.

扫.name: sweep

奔.def: to rush about; to run, to flee

ety.hint: A man 大 running through a field of grass 卉

origin.says: Early forms show a running person with swinging arms (夭) above three feet (止): to run fast. The three feet later turned into 卉 (grasses) and the person into 大 (big).

奔.name: dash

origin.says: 革 (leather) for the meaning plus 力 (strength) as the sound: a leather bridle, hence to rein in, tighten or strangle. One source reads it the other way round, with 革 as the sound.

耐.def: to resist, to bear; patient, enduring

origin.says: 而 (beard) as the sound plus 寸 (hand) for the meaning: to bear, to endure. One old reading links it to shaving the beard as a mild punishment one had to endure.

耐.name: patience

埋.def: to bury; to conceal; to plant

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 里 (village) as the sound: to bury in the ground.

埋.name: bury

讼.def: to accuse, to argue; to dispute, to litigate

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 公 (public) as the sound: to argue in public, a lawsuit. Simplified from 訟, with 言 written 讠.

讼.name: lawsuit

ety.hint: A proud 乔 horse 马; 乔 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 乔 (tall) as sound and meaning: a tall, spirited horse holding its head high, hence proud, haughty. Simplified from 驕.

谴.def: to scold, to reprimand, to abuse

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 遣 (dispatch) as the sound: to scold, to condemn. Simplified from 譴.

谴.name: condemn

诊.def: to diagnose; to examine a patient

origin.says: Simplified from 診: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 㐱 (thick hair) as the sound: to question and examine a patient, to diagnose; 言 became 讠.

诊.name: diagnose

殖.def: to breed, to spawn; to grow, to prosper

origin.says: 歹 (bare bone, death) for the meaning plus 直 (straight) as the sound: first said of fat or rot, then to breed, multiply, prosper.

殖.name: breed

劫.def: to take by force, to coerce; disaster; misfortune

origin.says: 去 (to go) as the sound plus 力 (strength, force) for the meaning: to take by force, rob. In Buddhism it also writes 'calamity, an age of disaster'.

劫.name: robbery

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: a jade-like stone, now glass.
王 (jade) for the meaning plus 离 (leave) as the sound: a jade-like glassy stone; now glass.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 宾 (guest) as the sound: the edge of the water, a shore. Simplified from 濱, where 賓 became 宾.

坑.def: pit, hole; to trap, to bury; to harry

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound: a pit in the ground; early forms used 阝 (mound) instead.

坑.name: pit

拨.def: to stir, to move, to distribute, to allocate

ety.hint: To dispatch 发 goods by hand 扌

origin.says: From 撥: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 發 (send out) as the sound: to push aside with the hand, to allot. 發 was shortened to 发.

拨.name: flick aside

滋.def: to grow, to nourish; to multiply, to thrive

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 兹 as the sound: water that makes things grow, to nourish, to thrive; also taste.

滋.name: nourish

耀.def: to sparkle, to shine, to dazzle; glory

ety.hint: A peacock 翟 with a brilliant 光 tail

origin.says: 光 (light) for the meaning plus 翟 (pheasant feathers) as the sound: light that dazzles. The feathers fit the picture of a bright, showy tail, but they were chosen for the sound.

耀.name: dazzle

ety.hint: An ugly 丑 sheep 羊

origin.says: 羊 (sheep) plus 丑 as the sound (earlier 又, hand): a hand offering mutton, a delicacy. The meaning 'shame, shy' came later by borrowing.

辱.def: to insult, to humiliate, to abuse

origin.says: 辰 (a clam-shell hoe) plus 寸 (hand): a hand with a hoe, field work. The meaning disgrace, insult came later.

辱.name: insult

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 失 (lose) as the sound: sheaves of grain piled in rows, hence order, sequence.
A picture of an eye turned upright, a man looking down with lowered eyes: a servant bowing before a lord, hence a minister. The eye sense survives in characters such as 臨 (look down on).

ety.hint: A necklace 丨 adorned with three pieces of jade

origin.says: A picture of pieces of jade strung on a cord, or a ritual jade object. A dot was added to tell it apart from 王 (king).

摇.def: to rock, to shake; to swing, to wave

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 䍃 (a pot shape) as the sound: to shake, to rock, to wave.

摇.name: shake

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 九 (nine) as the sound: first a partner or match, then the one you are matched against, an enemy; hatred.

耗.def: to consume, to use up; to squander, to waste

origin.says: Built with 毛 (hair) as the sound; the meaning part, first 禾 (grain), is now 耒 (plough). It meant using up grain and stores, hence to consume or waste.

耗.name: drain

ety.hint: A hand 爫 over a woman 女, representing control

origin.says: 爫 (hand) over 女 (woman): a hand calming a woman, to soothe, settled; hence secure, proper, appropriate.
Simplified from 肅, a hand with a brush (聿) over a deep pool; one old reading sees a person trembling at the edge of an abyss, hence solemn, respectful. The simplified form is a cursive outline.

刊.def: publication, periodical; to publish, to print

origin.says: 干 (shield) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to cut, carve into wood blocks, hence to print, a periodical.

刊.name: periodical

origin.says: 米 (rice) for the meaning plus 唐 (Tang) as the sound: first a sweet rice cake or syrup, now sugar and sweets.
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 且 (altar) as the sound: unpolished, coarse grain, hence rough and thick.

凌.def: pure; virtuous; to insult; to maltreat

origin.says: 冫 (ice) for the meaning plus 夌 (to climb over) as the sound: first piled-up ice; now to rise above, to bully, and early dawn.

凌.name: bully

涂.def: to smear, to scribble, to daub; surname

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 余 (surplus) as the sound: first a river name. In simplified writing it also replaces 塗 (涂 + 土 earth: mud, to smear), hence to smear, to daub.

涂.name: smear

抑.def: to curb, to hinder; to keep down, to repress

origin.says: 扌 (hand) added to 印 (seal, once a hand pressing a person down) to keep the old meaning: to press down, to repress. Its right side is now written like 卬 (raise).

抑.name: hold down

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 亶 (sincere) as the sound: to take into one's own hands, to act on one's own, to be good at.

御.def: chariot; to drive, to ride; to manage

origin.says: Oldest form: 午 (pestle) as the sound plus 卩 (kneeling person), to govern; 彳 (step) and 止 (foot) were added for action: to drive a chariot, to manage. 禦 (ward off) was merged into it.

御.name: charioteer

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 堇 (clay) as the sound: careful in speech, cautious, prudent. Simplified from 謹 by the short speech radical.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 畏 (dread) as the sound: a call, 'hey', 'hello', and also to feed.
廴 (stride) for the meaning plus 𡈼 (a man standing on the ground) as the sound: the royal court, where hearings were held. The sound part now looks like 壬 (ninth stem).

崇.def: high, dignified; to esteem, to honor

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 宗 (ancestral shrine) as the sound: high like a mountain, so lofty and honoured.

崇.name: high esteem

割.def: to cut, to divide, to partition; to cede

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus 害 (harm) as the sound: to cut with a blade.

割.name: knife cut

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 夆 (meet) as the sound: the top of a mountain, a peak.
心 (heart) for the meaning plus 因 (cause) as the sound: kindness, a favour felt in the heart.

驱.def: to spur a horse on; to expel, to drive away

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: to spur a horse on, to drive away. Simplified from 驅 by the cursive horse 马 and the shorthand 区.

驱.name: drive away

滑.def: to slip, to slide; slippery, polished

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 骨 (bone) as the sound: wet and slippery, to slide.

滑.name: slippery

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 嵒 (rock, a variant of 岩) for the sound and meaning: an illness of hard lumps, cancer.
酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 卒 (soldier, to finish) as the sound: drunk.
反 (to turn against) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound: to turn against one's side, to rebel.
力 (strength) for the meaning plus 堇 (clay) as the sound: putting in effort, diligent.

耳.def: ear; to hear, to hear of; handle

origin.says: A drawing of an ear.

耳.name: ear
耳.in: 最联取闻职趣辑摄敢聚聊聘聪耻娶骤橄耽缉聋茸耸撮椰饵耿聂聆憨

ety.hint: Fitting 宜 speech 讠; 宜 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 宜 (fitting) as the sound: fitting conduct between people, friendship. Simplified from 誼.
𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 朱 (vermilion) as the sound: a precious round stone, a pearl or bead.

挤.def: to squeeze, to push against; crowded

origin.says: From 擠: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 齊 (even) as the sound, to push and squeeze. The simplified form uses 齐 (even).

挤.name: squeeze

闪.def: flash, lightning; to dodge, to evade

ety.hint: A man 人 just glimpsed through a door 门

origin.says: Simplified from 閃: a person (人) seen in a gateway (門), glimpsed for a moment: to flash, to dodge. 門 is written 门.

闪.name: flash

雕.def: to carve, to engrave; eagle, vulture

origin.says: 隹 (bird) for the meaning plus 周 (circuit) as the sound: a large bird of prey, the eagle; it is also used for 'to carve', taking over the meaning of related characters.

雕.name: eagle carving
